arxiv-2012-06347.creator: Kleber Carrapatoso, Jean Dolbeault, Frédéric Hérau, Stéphane Mischler, Clément Mouhot
arxiv-2012-06347.description: Abstract . We prove functional inequalities on vector fields u : ℝ d → ℝ d u:{\mathbb{R}}^{d}\to{\mathbb{R}}^{d} when ℝ d {\mathbb{R}}^{d} is equipped with a bounded measure e − ϕ ​ d ​ x e^{-\phi}\,\mathrm{d}x that satisfies a Poincaré inequality, and study associated self-adjoint operators.

arxiv-2106-07337.title: Speech Disorder Classification Using Extended Factorized Hierarchical Variational Auto-encoders
arxiv-2106-07337.creator: Jinzi Qi, Hugo Van hamme
arxiv-2106-07337.description: Abstract Objective speech disorder classification for speakers with communication difficulty is desirable for diagnosis and administering therapy. With the current state of speech technology, it is evident to propose neural networks for this application. But neural network model training is hampered by a lack of labeled disordered speech data.

arxiv-2203-02219.title: At least three xenon binding sites in the glycine binding domain of the N-methyl D-aspartate receptor
arxiv-2203-02219.creator: Yves-Henri Sanejouand
arxiv-2203-02219.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yves-Henri Sanejouand. Abstract Xenon can produce general anesthesia. Its main protein target is the N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor, a ionotropic channel playing a pivotal role in the function of the central nervous system. The molecular mechanisms allowing this noble gas to have such a specific effect remain obscure, probably as a consequence of the lack of structural data at the atomic level of detail.

arxiv-2212-04581.title: PALMER: Perception-Action Loop with Memory for Long-Horizon Planning
arxiv-2212-04581.creator: Onur Beker, Mohammad Mohammadi, Amir Zamir, Swiss Federal Institute of Technology (EPFL)
arxiv-2212-04581.description: Abstract To achieve autonomy in a priori unknown real-world scenarios, agents should be able to: i) act from high-dimensional sensory observations (e.g., images), ii) learn from past experience to adapt and improve, and iii) be capable of long horizon planning. Classical planning algorithms (e.g. PRM, RRT) are proficient at handling long-horizon planning.

arxiv-2212-10135.title: Using Witten Laplacians to locate index-1 saddle points Thanks: Submitted to the editors August 9, 2026.
arxiv-2212-10135.creator: Tony Lelièvre, Panos Parpas
arxiv-2212-10135.description: Abstract We introduce a new stochastic algorithm to locate the index-1 saddle points of a function V : ℝ d → ℝ V:{\mathbb{R}}^{d}\to{\mathbb{R}} , with d d possibly large. This algorithm can be seen as an equivalent of the stochastic gradient descent which is a natural stochastic process to locate local minima.

arxiv-2305-09657.title: Newad: A register map automation tool for Verilog
arxiv-2305-09657.creator: Vamsi K Vytla, Larry Doolittle
arxiv-2305-09657.description: Abstract Large scale scientific instrumentation-and-control FPGA gateware designs have numerous run-time settable parameters. These can be used either for user-level control or by automated processes (e.g., calibration). The number of such parameters in a single design can reach on the order of 1000, and keeps evolving as the gateware and its functionality evolves.

arxiv-2310-02975.title: ( ϵ , u ) (\epsilon,u) -Adaptive Regret Minimization in Heavy-Tailed Bandits
arxiv-2310-02975.creator: Gianmarco Genalti, Lupo Marsigli, Nicola Gatti, Alberto Maria Metelli
arxiv-2310-02975.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Gianmarco Genalti, Lupo Marsigli, Nicola Gatti, Alberto Maria Metelli. Heavy-tailed distributions naturally arise in several settings, from finance to telecommunications. While regret minimization under subgaussian or bounded rewards has been widely studied, learning with heavy-tailed distributions only gained popularity over the last decade.

arxiv-2312-09648.title: Structure of single Λ \Lambda -hypernuclei with Gogny-type Λ \Lambda -nucleon forces
arxiv-2312-09648.creator: C.V. Nithish Kumar 1,2 , L. M. Robledo 2,3 and I. Vidaña 4
arxiv-2312-09648.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by C.V. Nithish Kumar 1,2 , L. M. Robledo 2,3 and I. Vidaña 4. We study the structure of single Λ \Lambda -hypernuclei using the Hartree–Fock–Bogoliubov method. Finite range Gogny-type forces are used to describe the nucleon-nucleon and Λ \Lambda -nucleon interactions. Three different Λ \Lambda -nucleon Gogny forces are built. The unknown parameters of these forces are obtained by fitting the experimental binding energies of the 1 ​ s 1s Λ \Lambda single-particle state in various hypernuclei using the “Simulated Annealing Method”.

arxiv-2403-18175.title: 12th Workshop on the CKM Unitarity Triangle Santiago de Compostela, 18-22 September 2023 Summary of the CKM 2023 Working Group on V u ​ b V_{ub} , V c ​ b V_{cb} and semileptonic/leptonic B B decays including τ \tau
arxiv-2403-18175.creator: William I. Jay, Raynette van Tonder, Ryoutaro Watanabe
arxiv-2403-18175.description: Abstract This work summarizes recent results, both theoretical and experimental, in B B -meson leptonic and semileptonic decays and metrology of V u ​ b V_{ub} and V c ​ b V_{cb} , which were presented at the CKM 2023 workshop. We place these results in context and discuss future prospects in the field.

arxiv-2404-02368.title: Astrophotonics: recent and future developments
arxiv-2404-02368.creator: Simon Charles Ellis a and Joss Bland-Hawthorn b
arxiv-2404-02368.description: Abstract Astrophotonics is a burgeoning field that lies at the interface of photonics and modern astronomical instrumentation. Here we provide a pedagogical review of basic photonic functions that enable modern instruments, and give an overview of recent and future applications. Traditionally, optical fibres have been used in innovative ways to vastly increase the multiplex advantage of an astronomical instrument, e.g.

arxiv-2505-24243.title: Model Informed Flows for Bayesian Inference of Probabilistic Programs
arxiv-2505-24243.creator: Joohwan Ko, Justin Domke
arxiv-2505-24243.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Joohwan Ko, Justin Domke. Variational inference often struggles with the posterior geometry exhibited by complex hierarchical Bayesian models. Recent advances in flow-based variational families and Variationally Inferred Parameters (VIP) each address aspects of this challenge, but their formal relationship is unexplored. Here, we prove that the combination of VIP and a full-rank Gaussian can be represented exactly as a forward autoregressive flow augmented with a translation term and input from the model’s prior.

arxiv-2509-09835.title: A risk-sensitive ergodic singular stochastic control problem
arxiv-2509-09835.creator: Justin Gwee, Mihail Zervos
arxiv-2509-09835.description: Abstract We consider a two-sided singular stochastic control problem with a risk-sensitive ergodic criterion. In particular, we consider a stochastic system whose uncontrolled dynamics are modelled by a linear diffusion. The control that can be applied to the system is modelled by an additive finite variation process.

arxiv-2511-13145.title: Automated Road Distress Detection Using Vision Transformers and Generative Adversarial Networks
arxiv-2511-13145.creator: Cesar Portocarrero Rodriguez *, Laura Vandeweyen, Yosuke Yamamoto
arxiv-2511-13145.description: Abstract The American Society of Civil Engineers has graded America’s infrastructure condition as a C, with the road system receiving a dismal D. Roads are vital to regional economic viability, yet their management, maintenance, and repair processes remain inefficient, relying on outdated manual or laser-based inspection methods that are both costly and time-consuming.

pmc-11827016.title: Applying kinetic models to the study of the influence of wood contact surface area/volume ratio on the ageing of Brandy deJerez
pmc-11827016.creator: Rocío Trillo-Ollero, Luis M Trillo-Gutiérrez, M Valme García-Moreno, M Carmen Rodríguez-Dodero, Dominico A Guillén-Sánchez
pmc-11827016.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The present study investigates the influence of the casks’ wood surface/volume ratio on the extraction processes that take place during the first stages of the production of Sherry Brandy. For this purpose, the ageing of a spirit at 60% alcoholic strength has been examined in casks of two different volumes: 500 L and 250 L, made from three different types of wood: Quercus alba (American oak), Quercus robur (French limousin oak) and Quercus petraea (Spanish oak), either previously seasoned or non-seasoned with

pmc-12565054.title: Oculomotor Behavior of L2 Readers with Typologically Distant L1 Background: The “Big Three” Effects of Word Length, Frequency, and Predictability
pmc-12565054.creator: Marina Norkina, Daria Chernova, Svetlana Alexeeva, Maria Harchevnik
pmc-12565054.description: Oculomotor reading behavior is influenced by both universal factors, like the “big three” of word length, frequency, and contextual predictability, and language-specific factors, such as script and grammar. The aim of this study was to examine the influence of the “big three” factors on L2 reading focusing on a typologically distant L1/L2 pair with dramatic differences in script and grammar.

pmc-12719064.title: Benchmarking transformer-based models for medical record de-identification in a single center multi-specialty evaluation
pmc-12719064.creator: Rachel Kuo, Andrew A.S. Soltan, Ciaran O’Hanlon, Alan Hasanic, David A. Clifton, Gary Collins, Dominic Furniss, David W. Eyre
pmc-12719064.description: SummaryProtecting patient confidentiality is central to enabling research using electronic health records. Automated text de-identification offers a scalable alternative to manual redaction. However, different approaches vary in accuracy and adaptability. We evaluated four transformer-based, task-specific models and five large language models on 3,650 clinical records spanning general and specialty datasets from a UK hospital group.

pmc-12842739.title: Paclitaxel- and Sirolimus-Coated Balloons Versus Drug-Eluting Stents in Coronary Artery Disease: A Comprehensive Narrative Review
pmc-12842739.creator: Flavius-Alexandru Gherasie, Al Hassan Ali, Ana Maria Corzanu, Eva Catalina Costescu, Sonia-Gabriela Cornea
pmc-12842739.description: Drug-coated balloons (DCBs) have emerged as an alternative to drug-eluting stents (DESs) in percutaneous coronary intervention, delivering antiproliferative drugs without leaving a permanent implant. This review provides a comparative analysis of sirolimus-coated DCBs (DCB-S), paclitaxel-coated DCBs (DCB-P), and DESs across key scenarios: de novo coronary lesions in chronic coronary syndrome (CCS), acute coronary syndromes (ACS), and in-stent restenosis (ISR).

pmc-12849176.title: Synergistic protective effects of rhizobacterial culture filtrate and zinc oxide nanoparticles against Pantoea leaf spot in cucumber
pmc-12849176.creator: Amira A Helaly, Amany H M Shams, Ibrahim A A Mohamed, Eman F A Awad-Allah
pmc-12849176.description: Global food security is increasingly threatened by plant diseases and the excessive use of chemical pesticides and fertilizers, highlighting the urgent need for sustainable and environmentally friendly alternatives. Nanotechnology and biological agents such as plant-growth-promoting rhizobacteria (PGPR), particularly Bacillus spp., offer cutting-edge strategies for sustainable crop protection.

pmc-12972960.title: Adult children's unemployment and parental mental health in India: Social and economic heterogeneity
pmc-12972960.creator: Rishabh Tyagi, Anna Baranowska-Rataj, Alexi Gugushvili
pmc-12972960.description: This study explores the relationship between adult children's unemployment and parental mental health. Given India's large inequalities in social capital and income, we examine the heterogeneous effects of these factors on the relationship. We utilise data from the Longitudinal Ageing Survey of India, which includes 73,396 individuals aged 45 and above.

pmc-12989694.title: Optimizing Filtration Surgery Procedures in African-Derived Populations: Trabeculectomy and Preserflo
pmc-12989694.creator: Gus Gazzard, Obeda Kailani, Hussameddin Muntasser, Kin Sheng Lim, Niten Vig, Jonathan Yu
pmc-12989694.description: BackgroundAfrican-derived populations are disproportionately affected by primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) and face increased risks of surgical failure due to anatomical and genetic factors. This report identifies challenges in glaucoma care and strategies to optimize surgical outcomes in patients from African-derived backgrounds.

pmc-13059666.title: Adjunctive Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy in the Multimodal Management of Refractory Gluteal Hidradenitis Suppurativa: A Case Report
pmc-13059666.creator: Arthur Cury Féres, Gabriel Valentim Souza, Rogério Serafim Parra, José Joaquim Ribeiro da Rocha, Omar Féres, Marley Ribeiro Feitosa
pmc-13059666.description: BackgroundHidradenitis suppurativa (HS) is a chronic, inflammatory skin disorder characterized by recurrent nodules, abscesses, and sinus tracts, frequently leading to significant morbidity. Severe cases often require surgical intervention, and multimodal approaches are increasingly being explored to optimize outcomes.Case PresentationWe report the case of a 49‐year‐old male with long‐standing, treatment‐refractory Hurley III HS affecting the gluteal and proximal thigh regions.

pmc-13239442.title: Comprehensive Integrated Single‐Cell and Spatial Transcriptomics Unveil the Dynamic Landscape of Betel Nut‐Associated Oral Mucosal Carcinogenesis and Its Tumor Microenvironment
pmc-13239442.creator: Wei Dong, Shuojin Huang, Yijun Wu, Congyuan Cao, Jiaxue Li, Qianting He, Anxun Wang
pmc-13239442.description: Betel nut chewing is a major etiological factor for oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC), yet its mechanistic underpinnings remain poorly defined. Here, we performed single‐cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics from six OSCC patients to comprehensively dissect the tumor microenvironment (TME) dynamics and cellular heterogeneity associated with betel nut‐induced oral mucosal carcinogenesis.

pmc-13278830.title: Developing age-inclusive mindsets in future managers: insights from a classroom intervention
pmc-13278830.creator: Maria Eduarda Soares, Chantale Jeanrie, Dinis Macedo, Susana Santos, Bruno Futre, Frederico Caetano, Abílio Zacarias, Paulo Almeida Gonçalves, Michelle Putnam
pmc-13278830.description: Background and ObjectivesThe increased participation of older workers in the labor force has brought about various challenges for managers. This study investigates whether a brief classroom-based intervention may influence management students’ attitudes toward older workers and their willingness to work with them.Research Design and MethodsThe intervention combined feedback on aging-related knowledge with testimonial videos from older workers.

pmc-13385907.title: The PLAGL1-KLF4-IRX5 axis promotes the osteogenesis of periosteal progenitors during mandible regeneration
pmc-13385907.creator: Enhui Yao, Yili Liu, Jingyi Xu, Zeqian Xu, Yilei Huang, Mingliang Zhou, Sihan Lin, Xinquan Jiang, Jiahui Du
pmc-13385907.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Transcription factor (TF) networks are pivotal regulators of stem/progenitor cell fate. However, the regulatory mechanisms mediated by key TFs in adult periosteal stem/progenitor cells (PSPCs) remain poorly understood, impeding targeted therapies development for craniofacial bone regeneration. By integrating an analysis of regeneration-related, tissue-specific TF networks with insights from embryonic development, we demonstrate that the imprinted TF PLAGL1 is critical for the osteoblast differentiation of PSPCs and that the loss of Plagl1 compromises mandibular bone regeneration.

pmc-13619808.title: Statin use and all-cause mortality in critically ill ischemic stroke patients: a time-dependent Cox analysis with external validation highlighting enhanced survival benefits in dementia subgroups
pmc-13619808.creator: Danyu Li, Ruixin Liu, Hui Xu, Hongjie Tong, Kun Chen, Jiali Yao
pmc-13619808.description: IntroductionIschemic stroke is a leading cause of mortality and disability, but the effect of statins on survival in critically ill patients, especially those with dementia, remains unclear.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study analyzed 1,964 patients from MIMIC-IV and validated findings in 4,255 external cases. Time-dependent Cox, IPTW, and PSM were applied.

uslaw-usc-t16-s230d.title: 16 U.S.C. § 230d — Hunting, fishing, and trapping; public safety; consultation
uslaw-usc-t16-s230d.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s230d.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 1 (National Parks, Military Parks, Monuments, And Seashores); Subchapter XXV (Jean Lafitte National Historical Park And Preserve); Part A (Generally). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Within the Barataria Preserve Unit, the Secretary shall permit hunting, fishing (including commercial fishing), and trapping in accordance with applicable Federal and State laws on land, and interests in land.
